P0_E_georeference.impact: CARLA 0.9.16 GeoReferenceParser accepts only +lat_0/+lon_0; absent -> fallback geolocation (42.0, 2.0) ~7.4 degrees from Ingolstadt; GNSS output is meaningless (audit P0 itself).

fixed_string_policy.designed_georeference: +proj=tmerc +lat_0=<origin lat> +lon_0=<origin lon> +k=1 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs where the origin is the inverse-NATIVE projection of the pinned rebase offset (map local (0,0))
fixed_string_policy.accuracy_envelope_note: max CARLA-linear equirectangular-vs-true-tmerc deviation over the scrubbed bbox measured at the far NE corner of the local extent; a documented projection-semantics limitation of the CARLA consumer, not a fixable offset
